feedback: Authored a proportional 2-task verify-and-ratify implementation plan derived from TDD v1.0. Tasks: TASK-001 (ratify hello.py against TDD §11.1) and TASK-002 (ratify test_hello.py against TDD §11.1). Single sequential track because the test file imports the symbol defined in hello.py. Total estimated effort 0.5 hour. All TDD design elements (greet function, __main__ guard, three pytest tests) are mapped to tasks. Working-tree inspection at authoring time confirms both files already match the TDD reference body, so executor work is verification-driven. No high-severity risks or blockers; PRD OQ-1/OQ-2 confirmed out of scope by TDD §13.
